newsitem.title: USA: Lee tapped to head NBD Mich. municipal banking.
newsitem.headline: Lee tapped to head NBD Mich. municipal banking.

text.p: Aubrey Lee has been appointed to head NBD Bank's municipal banking group in Michigan, the Detroit-based bank announced Wednesday.
Lee, a senior vice president, was not available to comment.

However, D'Arcy Gonzales, a vice president in the group, which was formed in January, said the seven bankers will act as the banks eye's and ears to identify municipal bond opportunities, as well as service other investment and general banking needs of municipalities and school districts.
"Anything and everything they need we will coordinate with respective parties (within the bank)," Gonzales said.
For example, he said upcoming negotiated municipal bond deals would be forwarded to First Chicago Capital Markets, the investment banking arm of First Chicago NBD Corp.
In addition to Gonzales, NBD's municipal banking team is made up of John Garfield, Jack Pelton, Tom Richardson, Andy Small, Roberta Combs and Cheryl McFarland.
